announcements.headline: Kodal to explore Asamankese Lithium Project Ghana
announcements.insight: Kodal Minerals initiates exploration of the Asamankese Lithium Project in Ghana. This follows quarterly updates on its Bougouni Lithium Project.

announcements.headline: Result of General Meeting
announcements.insight: The AGM result follows the June directorate change. Shareholders should monitor the upcoming Bougouni Lithium Project update for operational developments.

announcements.headline: Bougouni Lithium Project Quarterly Update
announcements.insight: The quarterly update follows the December 2026 results. Shareholders should monitor for operational progress details.

announcements.headline: Result of Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results. A director change followed in June, indicating ongoing governance updates.

announcements.headline: Directorate Change

announcements.headline: Final Results for the 9 months to 31 December 2025
announcements.insight: Kodal Minerals publishes final results for the nine months to 31 December 2025. Shareholders should monitor the post-AGM webcast scheduled for June 2026 for further updates.

announcements.headline: Post-AGM Webcast and Q&A Session
announcements.insight: Kodal Minerals hosts a post-AGM webcast for shareholder engagement. This provides an opportunity to hear management commentary following the annual general meeting.
